BL-902 — handoffd's briefing-email sweep composes the entire briefing before discovering RESEND_API_KEY is missing — a ~96s stall every cycle that blows the 120s freshness threshold and drives an all-day restart storm
What it solves: BL-903 and BL-904 came from this same intake and this same log. They are
independent of this ticket and can land in any order.
Approval context: One call worth your sign-off: severity `high` rather than `critical`.
The intake is explicit that this is "not currently a swarm-down emergency" — cool-off/restart keeps it self-healing — which rules out `critical`. It is above `medium` because the cost is paid on EVERY cycle and is unbounded in ti…
BL-902 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-902" (or "reject BL-902 <reason>") to act.
